name: How do I choose the right contractor for residential restoration maintenance?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for residential restoration maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose a restoration contractor who is hands-on, handles finish details personally, and can coordinate required sub-trades under a single point of contact. Many large restoration franchises handle structural dry-outs but subcontract out finish work, leading to mismatched textures or poorly aligned trim. Selecting an experienced general and finish carpenter ensures that drywall seams, custom baseboards, tile alignment, and paint matching blend smoothly into existing rooms. Always verify credentials, BBB standing, and verify that the contractor actively manages the job site rather than delegating the entire build to third parties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a hands-on contractor skilled in finish carpentry, tile, and drywall who acts as your direct contact and oversees needed specialty trades on site.
